title: The ordinary abelian sheafification class on module cycles
statement: Let Y be a ringed space, I any integer cochain complex of module sheaves on Y, q an integer, F its abelian presheaf-section functor and U the inclusion of abelian sheaves into presheaves. Put P=(I.sc(q)).map(F), and let k:P.cycles→F((I.sc(q)).cycles) be the inverse canonical kernel comparison. Then P.homologyπ followed by the abelian sheafification unit and U(localSectionComplexSheafificationIso(Y,q,I).hom) is k followed by F((I.sc(q)).homologyπ). The ordinary comparison is the exact functor and counit construction in [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf].

proof.text: Apply the generic adjoint homology comparison on cycles, proved in the module of the section cycle formula, to abelian sheafification and the short complex of underlying abelian sheaves. Identify the displayed exact sheafification comparison with that adjoint map followed by the exact homology comparison for module-to-abelian-sheaf forgetting.

Commute the cycle quotient through the latter exact functor. The two inverse kernel comparisons agree after composing with the monic kernel inclusion, hence agree. Substitute this identity to obtain the displayed class formula.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryLocalClass_cycles {Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) ℤ) (q : ℤ) :
    let F := RingedSpace.localAbelianSections Y
    let U := sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let P := (I.sc q).map F
    let k := (P.isoCyclesOfIsLimit
      (KernelFork.mapIsLimit _ (I.sc q).cyclesIsKernel F)).inv
    P.homologyπ ≫
        (sheafificationAdjunction (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).unit.app
          P.homology ≫
        U.map (RingedSpace.localSectionComplexSheafificationIso Y q I).hom =
      k ≫ F.map (I.sc q).homologyπ
